description: This file defines a Spring Data JPA repository interface for the Author entity, including methods for finding and deleting authors with associated books, utilizing entity graphs for optimized fetching.

classes.name: AuthorRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for managing Author entities, with custom methods for fetching authors with their books and deleting authors.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Finds an author by ID, including their books, using an entity graph for optimized fetching.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves all authors, including their books, using an entity graph.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a specific author, considering associated books via entity graph.

methods.name: deleteAll
methods.description: Deletes all authors, considering associated books via entity graph.
